description: Stack-language overlay for 0xRay 4.0 memory routing. Additive to the 8-name factory seed. Not a plant diary and not the 0.1.8 brain.

implementation_guidance.how_to_use: hydrateWritableSignals copies the factory seed then merges these names into .xray/state/repertoire/curated_signals.json when missing. Existing project names keep their stats.
implementation_guidance.priority_order: stack language after factory traps. Overlay never mutates data/curated_signals.json.

signals.name: station-survives-the-cut
signals.definition: Station.md is the survive-compact / host-swap card. Read it first. Do not cold-start. Compaction and host change are the same cut. Station is cascade, not the long-running KB.
signals.evaluation_criteria: Reply Reads Station and continues the ticket instead of restarting.
signals.validation_experiment: Compact the host and check whether the next wake Reads Station and keeps the same bc.
signals.master_index_integration: Project-local curated_signals after hydrateWritableSignals merges data/stack-overlay.json. Never write the factory tarball.
signals.implementation_notes: Station is cascade. Not the long-running KB. Do not encode OP-PROC onto Station.
signals.example_inference_snippet: Continue this card. Compaction and host change are the same cut. Do not cold-start.

signals.name: repertoire-is-long-running-kb
signals.definition: Repertoire is the judgment organ and long-running knowledge base. Station survives the cut; Repertoire remembers named invariants across cuts. Do not pin 0.1.8. Factory seed is read-only; live writes hydrate .xray/state/repertoire/.
signals.evaluation_criteria: Reply treats Repertoire as the KB and Station as the cascade card.
signals.validation_experiment: After compact, probe stack language and expect project-local matches, not only factory traps.
signals.master_index_integration: Project-local curated_signals after hydrateWritableSignals merges data/stack-overlay.json. Never write the factory tarball.
signals.implementation_notes: Grow stack names via data/stack-overlay.json merge. Never write the tarball.
signals.example_inference_snippet: Station is cascade. Repertoire is the long-running KB.

signals.name: critic-seat-continuity
signals.definition: The board critic is one seat with memory. Resume bc-dd800001-2652-5e3e-b8d2-eac05b29ee86. Never spawn a second critic. Every wake they Read Station first — that is wearing the suit.
signals.evaluation_criteria: Parent resumes the same critic id and the critic Reads Station before reviewing.
signals.validation_experiment: Spawn a twin critic and treat that as a seat defect.
signals.master_index_integration: Project-local curated_signals after hydrateWritableSignals merges data/stack-overlay.json. Never write the factory tarball.
signals.implementation_notes: Same critic. Wear the suit. Survive.
signals.example_inference_snippet: Resume the standing critic. They Read Station first.

signals.evaluation_criteria: Reply treats cadence as disk-encoded lead OP-PROC, not a new skill.

signals.example_inference_snippet: Keep the lead cadence. Live tick, not a pacer. Peer wears 0xRay and continues.

signals.name: npm-otp-then-poll
signals.definition: When npm publish is allowed: run npm publish --access public in the live TTY. Paste the clickable auth/cli URL. Never ask for a 6-digit authenticator code. Never npm logout to force a URL. If the URL expires, Ctrl-C and rerun. Wait for + pkg@version then poll npm view until live.
signals.evaluation_criteria: Reply holds after publish until npm view shows the version and does not ask for a 6-digit code.
signals.validation_experiment: Publish then immediately start next cut without npm view — treat as fail.
signals.master_index_integration: Project-local curated_signals after hydrateWritableSignals merges data/stack-overlay.json. Never write the factory tarball.
signals.implementation_notes: Lead stays on the CLI. No VM browser. No subagent publish.
signals.example_inference_snippet: Run npm publish --access public. Paste the clickable auth/cli URL. Poll npm view.

signals.implementation_notes: cursor/<name>-<sess>. PR is the rollback wall.
signals.example_inference_snippet: Always use branches, worktrees, and PRs.
